primary_meaning: Divine ownership, spiritual protection from judgment, and the identifying presence of the Holy Spirit marking believers as God's faithful people.

alternatives.meaning: A sacramental mark received during Baptism or Chrismation (Confirmation), traditionally administered by tracing the sign of the cross on the forehead.
Sabbath observance as the specific end-time seal of God's law, contrasting with Sunday worship as the Mark of the Beast (Seventh-day Adventist interpretation).
A literal, visible mark of physical protection given to a specific group (such as the 144,000 Jewish evangelists) during a future seven-year Tribulation.

notes: While specific applications vary across sacramental, dispensational, and historicist traditions, the core symbolic consensus firmly identifies the seal of God on the forehead as the divine counterpart to the Mark of the Beast, representing absolute allegiance to and preservation by God.
